name: building-blocks-avatars
title: Avatars
description: Compact Tailwind identity atoms for initials, presence, stacked participants, and square media placeholders.
useWhen: Compact Tailwind identity atoms for initials, presence, stacked participants, and square media placeholders.
avoidWhen: Avoid avatars when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Avatars uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
